title: IKEA Run
time: A Saturday — the first sleep after act2_guitar_done (Sameer's chat sets it up)
player_goal: Buy flat-pack furniture at Nagasandra and get it home on the metro.
design_goal: Progress: the Green Line opens to you (metro_tier_1 from 2.2 → Majestic interchange → Nagasandra) — the map grows past one line. Challenge: a carry limit (box slots) turns shopping into choosing, and the boxes make the metro ride a comedy. Reward: the flat gains furniture by flag (ADR-122). Seed for Act 4: the kitchen table does not fit — it waits folded against the wall and becomes the crafting bench in 4.2.

cast.role: Lost between the Purple and Green stairs with a jute sack. Walk him (companion) to the Green stairs: +1 rep, a guava (majestic_helped). Or point: he goes alone, muttering 'green'.
Yellow polo: the arrows are the law; delivery ₹1,499 'next Thursday, maybe'; three boxes comfortable, four brave, five the guard stops you.
Tills: checks you out (ikea_paid), blue bag ₹20; empty trolley → back to the aisle.
The ride home: your box lands on her foot. Hold it up (+1), argue (−1), give her the door spot (+1); with four boxes the top one slides and the coach laughs.

beats.what: The first sleep after the guitar: Sameer's chat — Hyggeland (the parody blue-and-yellow store) opened at Nagasandra. Maps shows the Green Line as ridable (metro_tier_1) with Nagasandra marked. Sameer cancels on the morning of, so it's you alone.

METRO from Cubbon Park / MG Road / Whitefield → the Majestic interchange (new compressed pocket, underground): crowd, two sets of stairs with Purple and Green signs, the lost uncle with the jute sack. Down the Green stairs → a Green Line coach card → Nagasandra.

Hyggeland (new interior pocket): arrows on the floor through three room sets — kitchen, living room, bedroom — each with a price tag you can inspect; the café (₹49 cinnamon bun, ₹79 'masala meatballs'); the self-serve aisle where you pick up boxes by number.

The carry limit: 3 box slots (the HUD shows ▢▢▢). Kitchen table + two chairs ₹4,999 (2 slots) · bookshelf ₹2,499 (2 slots) · floor lamp ₹999 (1) · rug ₹1,499 (1) · shoe rack for Sameer ₹699 (1). Pick at the self-serve aisle (each box is paid as you scan it), check out at the till; a fourth slot is possible but the metro beat gets harder. Delivery (₹1,499, 'next Thursday') is offered and refused by default — the scene is about carrying.

The ride home: Green Line coach (the metro_interior pattern, green stripe) → change at Majestic (a card) → Purple Line to Whitefield. The boxes take the door space; the aunty beat (three choices, ±rep); with 4 boxes one slides on a brake and the coach laughs. Off at Whitefield, the hill bus — the conductor sighs and makes you buy a luggage ticket (₹10 per box).

Assembly at the flat: step to the boxes → a three-step dialogue 'manual' (step 2 has a wrong option; one screw is always left over). Shelf, lamp, rug appear as objects by flag. The kitchen table does not fit — there's a cot, a table-chair and a stove already — so it stays folded against the wall ('One day you'll have a kitchen. Or a reason.').
Sameer's chat: 'Did you get my shoe rack?' — yes (he pays you back ₹699 by UPI) or no ('Typical.'). Act 4 reads table_folded (the crafting bench) and the shelf (base storage).

economy.trigger: metro to Majestic + Green Line to Nagasandra (ADR-115 fare, one fare for the trip)
shoe rack (for Sameer; ₹699 back by UPI)
luggage ticket on the hill bus, per box

exits.note: 25 s Green Line ride (busRide, green_ride_over) → hyggeland store_entrance
unlock ikea_paid; 30 s ride (home_ride_over) → whitefield_street player_spawn (where METRO arrivals land; station_mouth sits on the stairs exit)

assets_needed: green coaches reuse the metro_interior map (no recolour in this build)
ikea_props sheet: boxes, small box, folded table, bookshelf, lamp, rug (done)
npc_majestic_uncle, npc_hygge_staff (one sheet for staff, café and tills) (done); the aunty uses crowd_homemaker
HUD: BOXES n/3 on the plate under the clock (done)
acceptance: the first sleep after act2_guitar_done sets ikea_planned; Sameer's chat lands; Maps offers METRO to Majestic (metro_tier_1) before the first visit
Majestic: the uncle can be walked to the Green stairs (+rep) or pointed at; the Green stairs ride to Nagasandra
Hyggeland: the arrows, three room sets with inspectable price tags, the café, the aisle; the carry limit shows on the HUD and refuses a box past the limit ('Not enough space')
the till takes the total through spend(); with less money the expensive boxes are locked with 'Needs ₹N'
the ride home places the boxes, runs the aunty beat, charges the hill bus luggage ticket per box
assembly places the bought shelf / lamp / rug as flat objects by flag; the table stays folded (table_folded) whatever else you bought
Sameer pays back ₹699 if you brought the shoe rack
the walkthrough bot plays 2.4 and the headless run stays green (14 of 14)
decided: User 2026-10-17: 'Take the defaults.' — every open question resolved by the draft's default (ADR-132).
